title_sq: Afer Gjimnazit Andon Zako Cajupi, Shitet Apartament 2+1 i Sapo Investuar !
description_sq: Afer Gjimnazit Andon Zako Cajupi, ne rrugen Besim Zyma, shitet Apartament 2+1, me Ambient Gatimi Me Vete i Sapo Investuar. Apartamenti ndodhet ne katin e 4 ne nje pallat ekzistues 5 katesh dhe ka siperfaqe 73 m2. Organizimi apartamentit fillon me korridorin i cili ben shperndarjen ne sallonin e ndenjes me ambient gatimi me vete dhe me dalje ne ballkon, 2 dhoma gjumi, nje tualet me dritare dhe nje ballkon. Apartamenti eshte totalisht i investuar, duke filluar nga instalimet elektrike dhe hidraulike, parket, vetrata, dera e jashtme dhe dyert e brendshme, tualeti tersisht i rinovuar etj. Orientimi perfekt jug-lindje-perendim ben qe apartamenti te kete diell dhe drite gjate gjithe dites. Zona ne te cilen ndodhet apartamenti ofron te gjitha facilitetet per nje jetese sa me komode duke marr parasysh shkollat, cerdhet, spitalet, markete etj.
title_en: Close to Andon Zako Cajupi High School, Newly Invested 2+1 Apartment for Sale!
description_en: Near the Andon Zako Cajupi Gymnasium, on Besim Zyma Street, 2+1 Apartment for sale, with its own Kitchen, Newly Invested. The apartment is located on the 4th floor of an existing 5-story building and has an area of ​​73 m2. The organization of the apartment begins with the corridor, which divides into the living room with its own kitchen and access to the balcony, 2 bedrooms, a bathroom with window and a balcony. The apartment is fully invested, starting with electrical and plumbing installations, parquet, windows, external and internal doors, thirdly renovated toilet, etc. The perfect south-east-west orientation makes the apartment have sun and light throughout the day. The area in which the apartment is located offers all the facilities for a comfortable life, taking into account schools, nurseries, hospitals, markets, etc.
